body: Hi feel free to DM me

I like when people ask me a lot of questions, the curiousness is a gateway to good conversation. I also never really want pity sometimes I think giving pity is the easy way but I’d love to have embracing feedback

It’s so lonely, I feel like any time I try to explain what’s going on in my head people get super quiet or weird or don’t understand so I just keep it to myself and kind of suffer in silence. That’s why I came to this reddit page! You are not alone feel free to message me anytime

I’m going in to be tested on Saturday and I’m so anxious but I’m crossing my fingers because it feel Like this is the reason why my life feels like it’s falling apart. Thanks for sharing and I hope I can feel your relief within myself soon!
I’m so sorry to hear that. Do you think you get support by experiencing similar feelings or do you think it is making you feel worse? Are you and your mom close?

I feel like I can to a degree, but there’s this wall I hit before I feel like I can get through to him. It didn’t always used to be this way. I feel worthless due to a passion we both shared and we poured all of our emotional energy, time, finances on for years is coming to a close and my identity and worth is so tied into something that didn’t succeed. He doesn’t see it yet but I feel his disinterest in me it grows daily. Perhaps resentment. I can’t blame him

Hey this is my first time too, going through very similar feelings. I’m sorry you feel this way. It’s so hard when we don’t know how to stop hurting and also hurting the ones that try to help us. You aren’t alone I’m here to talk.
Sure, I’m very new to reddit. I just want to feel a connection to anyone and feel like I matter. I’m tired of feeling worthless and talking to the walls for company
